component.name: Orpheus
component.summary: Music player for Jellyfin, Emby and Navidrome

description.p: Orpheus, a fork of JellyBox, is a native music player for your own Jellyfin, Emby or Navidrome server. Browse your library, build and sync playlists, download albums for offline listening, and keep playback going from the media keys and the desktop media controls.
